bars_carried_forward.comparability: carried forward from a DIFFERENT readout and reported beside catch_rate_T3a_past80 for reference only: T3a scores 1,500 states of the actor's own UNCHANGED rollouts (first 200 strong-current starts), each signal flagged above its 95% level set on T4 (5,000 rows of the calibration split, gap removed, bank rows left out); the bars came from rule-modified rollouts, an exact-return switch (the 67%) and a different threshold pool (the 35%)
bars_carried_forward.distance_check_readout: trigger (b), new (state, command): the distance to the 10th-nearest training (state, command) row above its 95% split-conformal level, set on the held-out calibration-split rows (about 16,800 rows, the removal rule applied); 35% = the share of the actor's past-80% proposals it caught, counted along rollouts that the clip fallback changed whenever the trigger fired
bars_carried_forward.exact_one_step_check_readout: trigger (c), an exact-return comparison, not a scored signal and with no level: switch when the clipped command followed by the actor has a higher exact return than the actor's own command followed by the actor; 67% = the share of past-80% proposals on which it switched, counted along rollouts that the clip fallback changed
